responsibility: Implements the on-disk incremental query cache used by the query engine. This file defines the serialized cache format and footer/index structures, manages memory-mapped cache data from the previous session, records and reloads cached query results and query side effects by dep-node index, and provides the specialized encoders/decoders needed to persist and reconstruct rustc data such as spans, hygiene information, source files, symbols, `DefId`s, and interpreter allocations across compilation sessions.
